newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq completes oil sales under six-month U.N. deal.
newsitem.headline: Iraq completes oil sales under six-month U.N. deal.

text.p: Iraq's Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed said on Friday that Iraq completed more than a week early the exports of limited amounts of oil under its six-month deal with the United Nations, which is due for renewal on June 9.

"Today Iraq has completed the export of the last barrel of crude oil amounting to 120 million barrels since the start of the implementation of the memorandum of understanding on December 10," Rasheed said in a news conference in Baghdad.
